scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle.
A person operating a motor vehicle.
A designated area that allows pedestrians to safely cross roads where there are no traffic lights.
A broken white line separating traffic lanes that indicates passing may be permitted when the way is clear.
A solid line at the left of a lane that indicates passing is unsafe.
A rail vehicle for public transport.

rules.title: Do not pass unless sure it is safe
rules.when: the PASSER is not sure a PASS can be done without danger to the PASSER or others
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is not sure a PASS can be done without danger to the PASSER or others, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.

rules.title: Do not pass moving snow plows
rules.when: a MOVING SNOW PLOW is ahead
rules.statement: WHEN a MOVING SNOW PLOW is ahead, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the MOVING SNOW PLOW.

rules.title: Do not race when being passed
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up, the PASSER MUST NOT race the vehicle.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another DRIVER is trying to pass the DRIVER
rules.statement: WHEN another DRIVER is trying to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: Handbook states it is unlawful and dangerous.

rules.title: Avoid cutting off vehicle after pass
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: cut off the vehicle ahead by suddenly moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER SHOULD NOT cut off the vehicle ahead by suddenly moving in front of it.

rules.title: Signal intent to pass
rules.when: the PASSER intends to PASS
rules.action: use the left-turn signal to show intent and check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to PASS, the PASSER MUST use the left-turn signal to show intent and check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane.

rules.title: Watch for hidden cyclists and small vehicles
rules.when: the PASSER intends to PASS
rules.action: watch for CYCLISTS and small vehicles hidden from view in front of the vehicle to be passed
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to PASS, the PASSER MUST watch for CYCLISTS and small vehicles hidden from view in front of the vehicle to be passed.

rules.title: Signal before returning to lane
rules.when: the PASSER has completed a PASS
rules.action: signal intent to move back into the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has completed a PASS, the PASSER MUST signal intent to move back into the original lane.

rules.title: Wait until passed vehicle visible in mirror
rules.when: the PASSER intends to return to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: wait until the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the inside mirror
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to return to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER MUST wait until the entire front of the passed vehicle is visible in the inside mirror.

rules.title: Move right to let faster traffic pass
rules.when: faster traffic wants to PASS the DRIVER
rules.action: move to the right and let it pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to PASS the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and let it pass in safety.

rules.title: Move right for truck passing in left lane
rules.when: a truck wants to PASS the DRIVER on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN a truck wants to PASS the DRIVER on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction, the DRIVER MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as it is safe to do so.

vague_terms.term: as soon as it is safe to do so

rules.title: No passing within 30 metres of pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.

rules.title: No passing left of centreline near bridge
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass left of the centreline.

rules.title: No passing on crest or curve with obstructed vision
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill or a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed and there is not enough clear distance ahead to PASS in safety
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill or a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed and there is not enough clear distance ahead to PASS in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to PASS.

rules.title: Solid line prohibits passing
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

rules.title: Broken line permits passing when clear
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS, the PASSER MAY pass.

rules.title: Passing on right permitted in specific cases
rules.when: on a multi-lane road or one-way road OR overtaking a STREETCAR or a left-turning vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road or one-way road OR overtaking a STREETCAR or a left-turning vehicle, the PASSER MAY pass on the right.

rules.title: Avoid sudden right pass in leftmost lane
rules.when: driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front, the PASSER SHOULD NOT suddenly change lanes and pass on the right.

rules.title: Shoulder passing allowed only to pass left-turning vehicle on paved shoulder
rules.when: the PASSER wants to pass a vehicle turning left
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER wants to pass a vehicle turning left, the PASSER MAY drive on the right shoulder, UNLESS the shoulder is not paved.

rules.title: No passing on left shoulder
rules.when: the PASSER intends to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER intends to pass, the PASSER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder.

rules.title: Minimum 1 metre clearance when passing cyclist
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

rules.title: Change lanes to pass cyclist whenever possible
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass whenever possible.

rules.title: Do not follow too closely behind cyclists
rules.when: following a CYCLIST
rules.action: follow too closely behind the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN following a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT follow too closely behind the CYCLIST.

rules.title: Do not pass motorcycles and bicycles in same lane
rules.when: a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped is ahead
rules.statement: WHEN a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped is ahead, the PASSER MUST NOT pass in the same lane.

rules.title: Watch for opening doors when passing parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the PASSER MUST watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors.

rules.title: Pass streetcars on right unless one-way
rules.when: passing a STREETCAR
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving on a one-way road
rules.statement: WHEN passing a STREETCAR, the DRIVER MUST pass on the right, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Stay 2 metres behind stopped streetcar
rules.when: a STREETCAR is stopped at a stop
rules.action: stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors where passengers are getting on or off
rules.statement: WHEN a STREETCAR is stopped at a stop, the DRIVER MUST stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors where passengers are getting on or off.

rules.title: Use low beams when approaching vehicle from behind at night
rules.when: passing another vehicle at night
rules.action: switch headlights to low beams as the PASSER approaches the vehicle from behind
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle at night, the PASSER MUST switch headlights to low beams as the PASSER approaches the vehicle from behind.

rules.title: Use high beams when alongside vehicle at night
rules.when: the PASSER is moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is moving alongside the vehicle being passed at night, the PASSER MUST switch on high beams.

rules.title: Wait until front visible in mirror before pulling back at night
rules.when: passing at night
rules.action: wait until the entire front of the vehicle being passed is visible in the rear view mirror before pulling back into the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing at night, the PASSER MUST wait until the entire front of the vehicle being passed is visible in the rear view mirror before pulling back into the right lane.
